column1: # WiFi PrintDrive partition table for the 16 MB T-Dongle-S3 (shared by all firmware projects).
# Layout is OTA-ready from the start so that adding OTA later does not require
# re-partitioning (which would wipe the user file storage).
# FAT file storage (wear levelled). 0xAF0000 = 10.94 MiB raw; usable space is smaller
# (wear-levelling and FAT overhead). Ends exactly at 16 MiB.
